name: stylua
description: stylua — opinionated Lua code formatter. Auto-format Lua files with consistent style. Non-interactive, headless.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/releases/download/v2.1.0/stylua-linux-x86_64.zip && unzip -o stylua-linux-x86_64.zip && sudo mv stylua /usr/local/bin/ && rm stylua-linux-x86_64.zip
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo install.

commands.description: stylua — opinionated Lua code formatter. Auto-format Lua files with consistent style. Non-interactive, headless.
